## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Voxel grids
//
// Regular volumetric rasters, dense and sparse. All dense grids share one
// parameterization: Origin is the world position of the minimum corner of cell
// (0, 0, 0), CellSize is the world-space edge length of one cubic cell, and the
// grid's dimensions come from its value array. Cell (i, j, k) spans the
// half-open world box
// [Origin + (i,j,k)*CellSize, Origin + (i+1,j+1,k+1)*CellSize).

//==
// ## Dense voxel grids

// A dense 3D raster of arbitrary cell values over a regular grid
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voxel). The grid dimensions are those of
// Values.
type VoxelGrid3D<T>
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Values: Array3D<T>;
}

// A dense binary occupancy raster in the plane
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Occupancy_grid_mapping): floor plans,
// walkability masks, 2D rasterized regions. True means the cell is occupied.
type OccupancyGrid2D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Occupied: Array2D<Boolean>;
}

// A dense binary occupancy raster in space: voxelized solids, collision
// masks, volume selections. True means the cell is occupied.
type OccupancyGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Occupied: Array3D<Boolean>;
}

// A dense scalar raster in the plane: heightfields sampled as density,
// coverage maps, accumulation buffers.
type DensityGrid2D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point2D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Values: Array2D<Number>;
}

// A dense scalar raster in space: smoke, medical volumes, distance samples,
// occupancy probabilities. Values are unitless; interpretation is the
// producer's contract.
type DensityGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Values: Array3D<Number>;
}

// A dense color raster in space: baked volumetric lighting, color-mapped
// scans, voxel art.
type VoxelColorGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Colors: Array3D<Color>;
}

// A dense narrow-band signed-distance raster
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Signed_distance_function): negative inside,
// positive outside, in world units. Cells farther from the surface than
// NarrowBandWidth hold BackgroundDistance with the correct sign.
type LevelSetGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Distances: Array3D<Number>;
    NarrowBandWidth: Number;
    BackgroundDistance: Number;
}

//==
// ## Sparse voxel grids

// A sparse voxel raster: only occupied cells are stored. Coordinates holds
// integer cell coordinates (unique, sorted lexicographically Z, then Y,
// then X); Values is parallel to Coordinates. Cells not listed are empty.
type SparseVoxelGrid3D<T>
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    Coordinates: Array<IntegerVector3>;
    Values: Array<T>;
}

// One dense block of a two-level sparse volume. ICoordinate is the brick's
// position in brick units (world position = Origin + ICoordinate scaled by
// brick size times cell size); Values is the brick's dense payload, cubic
// with the owning map's BrickSize on each side.
type VoxelBrick3D
    implements IValue
{
    Coordinate: IntegerVector3;
    Values: Array3D<Number>;
}

// A two-level sparse volume: a sparse set of dense cubic bricks, each
// BrickSize cells on a side. Regions with no brick are empty. Bricks are
// unique and sorted by ICoordinate (lexicographically Z, then Y, then X).
type BrickMap3D
    implements IValue
{
    Origin: Point3D;
    CellSize: Number;
    BrickSize: Integer;
    Bricks: Array<VoxelBrick3D>;
}
```
